title: Display all Lead records from backend collection

requirements.summary: Create a page displaying all Lead records in a user-friendly table format
acceptanceCriteria: All lead records are fetched from the backend using the existing getAllLeads query
Records are displayed in a table with columns for all Lead fields (full name, email, country, target job role, timestamp)
Timestamps are formatted in a human-readable format
Loading and error states are handled appropriately
Empty state is shown when no records exist

file_operations.description: Create a new page component that displays all leads in a table format. Use the useAllLeads hook from frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to fetch data. Display columns for full name, email, country, target job role, and formatted timestamp. Handle loading state with a loading indicator, error state with an error message, and empty state when no records exist. Format timestamps from nanoseconds to human-readable format following the pattern in AdminPage.tsx.
Add a new route for the leads page at /leads path. Register the route in the router configuration to make the LeadsPage component accessible via navigation.
Add a navigation link to the new leads page in both desktop and mobile menus. Include appropriate label text and routing configuration to enable users to navigate to the leads display page.
